title: FIRST_VALUE and LAST_VALUE
description: For each employee, show their salary compared to the highest and lowest salary in their department. Use FIRST_VALUE and LAST_VALUE with window frames.
hints: FIRST_VALUE(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC) gives the highest
LAST_VALUE needs a frame: ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
Without the frame, LAST_VALUE only sees up to the current row
